// blast.browser.js is a prebuilt bundle that lives in public/assets/, copied there // from packages/browser by the copy-blast script. It is deliberately NOT part of // this app's module graph: the code the Blockly blocks generate imports it by URL // at runtime, so it has to stay a standalone file rather than be inlined here. // // The specifier is therefore built at runtime and marked @vite-ignore, so Vite // leaves it alone instead of trying to resolve and bundle it. Resolving against // document.baseURI keeps it correct under base './' whatever subpath the app is // deployed to. interpreter.ts calls window.resetServient() when a program stops. import(/* @vite-ignore */ new URL('assets/blast/blast.browser.js', document.baseURI).href) .then(module => { window.resetServient = module.resetServient; }) .catch(error => { console.error('Failed to load blast.browser.js', error); });
